items.question: In what ritual action is Gāyatrī established for the eradication of sin?
premises: Gāyatrī is established in a specific ritual context.
The ritual context is defined as an action of driving away sin.
The goddess is directly addressed as Devi.
items.inference: Gāyatrī is established in the rite of driving away sin.
items.plain_english: O goddess, Gāyatrī is established in the rite of driving away sin.
